2607.28077.title: LEEPS: Latent-Guided Explore-Exploit Prompt Sampling for Efficient RLVR in Large Language Models
2607.28077.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but prompt groups with identical rollout rewards consume generation budget without effective learning signals. Pre-rollout prompt selection can reduce this waste by screening prompts before rollout generation. However, existing pre-rollout methods struggle to balance exploitation and exploration: repeatedly exploiting historically informative prompts can narrow training coverage, whereas broader exploration can lower the fraction of informative prompts. To address these limitations, we introduce LEEPS, a Latent-Guided Explore--Exploit Prompt Sampler that adaptively balances the reuse of previously observed informative prompts with continued exploration of uncertain ones. LEEPS partitions candidates into exploit and explore portfolios and adaptively allocates rollout budget according to their recent non-trivial ratios. It further uses representation-space neighbors and historical rollout outcomes to prioritize uncertain prompts likely to yield non-zero reward variance, thereby making exploration more targeted without additional rollouts. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, LEEPS achieves the highest average score at both model scales, with relative gains of 2.6\% and 3.7\% over the strongest baseline for Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and 7B, respectively, and generally improves faster during the training process. It also achieves the highest average score across the three evaluated OOD general-reasoning benchmarks at both model scales and adds only about 2 seconds of online sampling overhead per training step. Code is available at https://github.com/ShuangLiangX/LEEPS.
2607.28077.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵（RLVR）提升了大型語言模型的推理能力，但具有相同回報的提示組在生成預算上消耗卻沒有有效的學習信號。預回報提示選擇可以通過在回報生成之前篩選提示來減少這種浪費。然而，現有的預回報方法在平衡利用和探索方面面臨挑戰：重複利用歷史上具資訊性的提示可能會縮小訓練覆蓋範圍，而更廣泛的探索則可能降低具資訊性提示的比例。為了解決這些限制，我們引入了LEEPS，一種潛在引導的探索--利用提示採樣器，能夠自適應地平衡對先前觀察到的具資訊性提示的重用與對不確定提示的持續探索。LEEPS將候選者劃分為利用和探索投資組合，並根據它們最近的非平凡比例自適應地分配回報預算。它還利用表示空間鄰居和歷史回報結果來優先考慮可能產生非零獎勵變異的不確定提示，從而使探索更具針對性，而無需額外的回報。 在六個數學推理基準測試中，LEEPS在兩個模型規模上都達到了最高的平均分數，對於Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B和7B，相對於最強基準分別提高了2.6\%和3.7\%，並且在訓練過程中通常進步更快。它在三個評估的OOD一般推理基準上也達到了兩個模型規模的最高平均分數，並且每個訓練步驟僅增加約2秒的在線採樣開銷。代碼可在 https://github.com/ShuangLiangX/LEEPS 獲得。
